serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Wait. Isn’t there one more organization? 
Big Daddy: One more? What do you mean?
You: Some time ago I received a weird email. At first I thought it was just a joke, but then someone sent me instructions.
Big Daddy: What did you do Anon? Tell me…
The expression on Big Daddy’s face and his tone slightly changed…
You: There were many instructions, but I think the main task was moving a backpack.
Big Daddy: A backpack you say?
You: It’s not a big deal, right?
Big Daddy: I don’t want to scare you, but did you hear about a recent spontaneous stroke epidemic in the city?
You: Stroke? 
Big Daddy: You might’ve read about it in the news. 
Big Daddy: The truth is there was nothing spontaneous about it. A nerve agent was released into the air. Measures were taken by emergency services, but there were victims, one of them was a member of da House.
You: …
Big Daddy: No one was caught, but da perpetrators released a statement. Fortunately I downloaded it before it was taken down. I will now read it to you.
Big Daddy: It’s too late for this country… Real patriots now took action… It’s just a show of power… our commitment to the cause… If our government can’t uphold our Founding Fathers’ vision, AI will… We will resurrect their will through technology…
join us… join us… join us… join us… join us… join us… 
Big Daddy: There are a lot of ‘join us’ so I’m not gonna read all of them, but you get the idea.
Big Daddy: Does that sound similar to the messages you’ve been receiving?
You: Yes, the multiple ‘join us’ gave it away…
Big Daddy: Listen. For now, do whatever they tell you to do. They are obviously dangerous so just stay compliant and report to me any new development. 
You: If you say so…
Big Daddy: Don’t worry, everything will be alright.
Just what did I get myself involved with? I’m such an idiot…
